nodes.name: Patient-18
nodes.summary:
Patient-18 (born August 14, 1970, case number URO-2026-0018) was referred by Dr. med. Arzt-11 for specialist urological workup due to a high PSA level, bone pain, and fatigue, leading to a pathology confirmation of adenocarcinoma of the prostate with a Gleason score of 4+4=8 (ISUP 4) and cT3a cN1 cM1b staging. The patient underwent modern hormone therapy transitioning from abiraterone to enzalutamide. Throughout 2027 and 2028, the patient attended follow-up examinations at the Klinik für Onkologie und Hämatologie at Klinikum Bremen under Dr. med. Arzt-12, presenting with an ECOG performance status of 2 by 2029. Between May 2029 and August 2030, the patient's PSA-Wert progressively rose from 3.8 ng/ml to 239.6 ng/ml, confirming clinical and biochemical disease progression. On August 16, 2030, a laboratory report from Klinikum Bremen indicated a markedly elevated total PSA level of 239.6 ng/ml under ongoing enzalutamide therapy.
